description: Unit tests for the PacFileDecider component in Chromium, testing PAC script fetching, DHCP fallback, auto-detect, and error handling scenarios.

classes.name: Rules
classes.description: Defines rules for PAC script URLs, including success and failure scenarios.

classes.name: RuleBasedPacFileFetcher
classes.description: Implements PacFileFetcher to return predefined PAC scripts based on rules.

classes.name: MockDhcpPacFileFetcher
classes.description: Mock implementation of DhcpPacFileFetcher for testing DHCP fallback.

classes.name: SynchronousSuccessDhcpFetcher
classes.description: Synchronous DHCP fetcher returning a predefined PAC script.

classes.name: AsyncFailDhcpFetcher
classes.description: Asynchronous DHCP fetcher that fails with a specific error.

methods.name: AddSuccessRule
methods.description: Adds a rule for a successful PAC script fetch.

methods.name: AddFailDownloadRule
methods.description: Adds a rule for a failed PAC script download.

methods.name: AddFailParsingRule
methods.description: Adds a rule for a PAC script that fails to parse.

methods.name: GetRuleByUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a rule matching a specific URL.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Fetches a PAC script based on rules, used by RuleBasedPacFileFetcher and DHCP fetchers.

methods.name: CompleteRequests
methods.description: Completes a DHCP fetch request with a specified result and script.

methods.name: SetPacURL
methods.description: Sets the PAC URL for DHCP fetcher.
